MORE THAN A PLACE TO SLEEP

An old Goan home.
A new favourite memory.

Walk up the steps to the balcao, then into a lounge filled with carved furniture, chandeliers and the easy warmth of a family holiday home.

Palacete Rodrigues sits in Mazal Vaddo, Anjuna. The mansion’s period details and green garden offer a gentle change of pace from the beach days and market wanderings outside.

A FEW HELPFUL DETAILS

Before you arrive.

Can I book instantly on this website?

This sample prepares a direct enquiry. Necila will confirm availability, the rate, payment arrangements and booking terms with you separately.

Where can I see the prices?

Ask for a quote for your dates, group size and preferred room. Confirmed current rates have not been supplied for this sample, so no indicative prices are displayed.

Are these photographs of the actual property?

These are AI-enhanced versions of archival photographs from the existing Palacete Rodrigues website. Lighting, colour and clarity have been improved, and fine details may differ from the originals. Please ask the host for current photographs and amenities before booking.

How do I get in touch?

Prepare an enquiry above, call +91 94220 56467 or email info@palacetegoa.com. Contact details are taken from the original property website; WhatsApp availability still needs the owner’s confirmation.

ABOUT THIS SAMPLE
Real place. Thoughtful refresh.
This independent concept was made for Necila to review. The existing website stays separate.
  • Official property website: identity, contact details, descriptions and source photographs. Website photos are AI-enhanced for lighting, colour and clarity; reconstructed details may differ.
  • Necila’s Airbnb listing: heritage mansion, Anjuna location and pool cross-check.
  • Goa Tourism registered hotel list, July 2025: property name and address.
Research checked 29 October 2026. Room inventory, current amenities, rates, contact preferences and photo usage should be approved by the owner before public launch. No reviews, ratings or prices have been invented.
Enquiry delivery: this version prepares WhatsApp and email messages. Automatic email delivery requires an email service and verified sending domain before launch.
